screen.audiozone.title: Audio Zone
audiozone.ui.tab.usage: Press Enter to open this tab. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs.
audiozone.ui.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
audiozone.ui.unsaved.message: You have changes that are not saved. Save them before closing?
audiozone.demo.title: UI kit demo
audiozone.demo.why: Why does this sound like this?
audiozone.demo.slider_keys: Slider keys: Left/Right step 5, Shift+Left/Right step 1.
audiozone.demo.delete_message: "Trading hall" and its 3 rules will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
audiozone.demo.help_message: Every control here can be used with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs. Esc closes dialogs with the safest choice.
audiozone.demo.error.volume: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200
audiozone.demo.tip.bypass: Demo only: in Audio Zone this plays every sound as in vanilla, ignoring all rules.
audiozone.demo.tip.plain_button: An ordinary text button. Pressing it updates "Last action".
audiozone.demo.tip.disabled_button: A disabled button: it cannot be pressed and Tab skips it.
audiozone.demo.tip.show_cue: Show a short on-screen cue when a muted sound plays.
audiozone.demo.tip.reduced_motion: Turn off list animations and toast slide-ins.
audiozone.demo.tip.volume_slider: Volume from 0 to 200%%. Above 100%% is louder than vanilla.
audiozone.demo.tip.volume_typed: Type a volume from 0 to 200; the slider follows.
audiozone.demo.tip.pattern: A sound ID pattern. * matches any text, e.g. minecraft:entity.villager.*
audiozone.demo.tip.open_two: Opens a dialog with two choices. Esc picks Cancel.
audiozone.demo.tip.open_three: Opens a dialog with three choices. Esc picks Keep editing.
audiozone.demo.tip.pretend_unsaved: When on, closing this screen asks whether to save first.
audiozone.ui.list.usage: Press Tab to enter the list. Up and Down move between rows, Left and Right between buttons, Page Up and Page Down by a page. Tab again leaves the list.
audiozone.ui.dropdown.usage: Press Enter to choose. Up and Down move, Enter picks, Esc cancels.
audiozone.ui.color.swatch.usage: Press Enter to choose this color
audiozone.demo.tip.refresh: Simulates new sounds arriving. The focused row and the scroll position stay put.
audiozone.demo.tip.apply_to: Where a new rule goes: everywhere, or into one zone.
audiozone.demo.tip.show_undo_toast: Shows a message with an Undo button for 5 seconds.
audiozone.recent.pause.tip: Freeze the list so you can read it. Shortcut: P while the list has focus.
audiozone.recent.sort.name: Name
audiozone.recent.filter.hint: Filter by name, ID or category
audiozone.recent.empty: No sounds yet. Sounds you hear appear here.
audiozone.settings.show_distance.tip: Show how far away each recently played sound was (Close, Near, Far). Turn off for servers that object to distance hints.
